question_text: What tradeoffs matter most in real-time rendering systems?

ranking.answer_fit_rationale: This is the strongest broad fit because it directly frames real-time rendering as balancing resolution, frame rate, shading complexity, reuse, artifacts, and hardware budget.
ranking.interestingness_rationale: It would improve the space by giving a cross-cutting vocabulary for temporal reuse, reprojection, amortization, and quality loss across many rendering subsystems.
ranking.overall_rationale: Best starting scout source for answering the prepared question at a systems level, despite a moderate citation signal compared with newer SIGGRAPH papers.

title: Temporal Coherence Methods in Real-Time Rendering

venue.name: Computer Graphics Forum
venue.reputation_rationale: Computer Graphics Forum is a long-running peer-reviewed graphics journal associated with Eurographics, and this article is a broad survey rather than a narrow demo paper.
